title: verbena megapotamica var. tweedieana
intro: Verbena megapotamica var. tweedieana, commonly known as the Argentine verbena or South American verbena, is a plant species within the Verbena genus. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, helping to soothe skin irritations and reduce fever. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reducing anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Verbena megapotamica var. tweedieana include verbascoside, verbenaoside, and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
